message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 78.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and cloud computing. I want to become a Programmer Analyst. My family can afford at most about USD 7200 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in hacking and cloud computing

explanation:
This program is ideal because it is located in Bengaluru, minimizing relocation stress, and boasts the highest placement rate (95%) and median salary ($21062), directly addressing your primary goal of securing a good job.

Located in Pune, this MTech program covers networking and cloud computing, aligning with your interests. It has a strong placement rate (83%) and the highest median starting salary ($15192) among programs near Bengaluru's preferred region.

This MTech program in Hyderabad combines cybersecurity (hacking interest) and networking/cloud. It is geographically favorable for you and offers a solid placement rate (80%) while staying well within your budget.

This MSc Cloud Computing program focuses on networking/cloud, matching your interests. It is located in Coimbatore and has a respectable median salary ($13015) and placement rate (83%), making it a strong value option.

This MTech Cyber Security program directly addresses your interest in hacking. While the salary is lower ($7369), its low tuition fee ($1150) and strong focus on cybersecurity make it a viable option if job security is prioritized over maximum initial salary.
